entries.6da65d8c317eeb63: KEYENCE CORPORATION, 39 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 affiliate (as of March 20, 2026) make up the group, and its main business is the manufacture and sale of electronic applied equipment. The company states that, based on the principles of “keeping the company alive forever” and “creating the greatest added value with the smallest capital and people,” it has pursued “creation of added value” and “business efficiency.” The company describes its strength as its “global direct sales structure” and says it uses this to strengthen product planning and development by linking its development and sales departments. For overseas operations as well, the company states its policy that promoting a direct sales structure, as in Japan, is important. Production is on a fabless basis: the quality control department works closely with partner factories that carry out production and is deeply involved in production, and its subsidiary KEYENCE ENGINEERING CO., LTD. manufactures products. Because the company maintains a system for immediate delivery, orders are almost equal to revenue, and order backlog is not significant.
entries.8c2405471098163c: The head office and research laboratory are in Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka, and house facilities for manufacturing, R&D, trade and administrative operations. In addition, there are a logistics center and a Takatsuki Office in Takatsuki, Osaka Prefecture, and a quality evaluation facility in Osaka City. Of the 39 consolidated subsidiaries, KEYENCE ENGINEERING CO., LTD. manufactures products, KEYENCE SOFTWARE CO., LTD. develops software, and most of the others are sales subsidiaries in various countries. As of March 20, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 12,784, and KEYENCE CORPORATION on a non-consolidated basis had 3,306.

entries.ca03be47be9964d3: The company provides sensors, measuring instruments, image system equipment and laser markers for factory automation, as well as microscopes for R&D and code readers for logistics and retail. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed a 3D printer for manufacturing sites that enables easy, high-quality molding even with functional resins having high strength, high heat resistance and chemical resistance, and a line-type cylinder sensor & smart valve that contributes to reducing equipment startup and adjustment man-hours. R&D expenses for the same fiscal year were ¥32,839 million.
entries.cc10feaa6ab91ff2: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,169,289 million, up 10.4% year on year.
entries.cc796af9c71eb58b: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating profit was ¥595,759 million (up 8.4% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥635,756 million (up 13.3%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥445,185 million (up 11.7%). Ordinary profit exceeds operating profit because interest income increased. The company has not set objective indicators for judging the achievement of its management targets, but it says it watches “revenue,” “gross profit” and “operating profit” as indicators of its contribution to society and aims to maximize them.
entries.d14f36c3ba9a736f: In North, Central and South America, sales are made through KEYENCE CORPORATION OF AMERICA and 3 other subsidiaries; in Europe, through KEYENCE DEUTSCHLAND GmbH and 4 others; and in Asia, through KEYENCE (CHINA) CO.,LTD. and 11 others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥390,066 million domestically and ¥779,222 million overseas (¥225,751 million in the United States, ¥186,550 million in China and ¥366,920 million in other regions). No single customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue, and the company's policy is risk diversification so as not to depend on specific products, customers, regions or industries.
entries.e4c33d3ac0eaabb7: A business that develops, manufactures and sells automatic control equipment, measuring instruments, information equipment and related electronic application equipment, optoelectronic equipment, and systems that use them. It handles sensors for factory automation, measuring instruments, image system equipment, laser markers, microscopes for research and development, and code readers for logistics and retail. KEYENCE CORPORATION itself develops, manufactures and sells products, KEYENCE Software Co., Ltd. handles software development for the products, and KEYENCE Engineering Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing the products. The securities report omits product- and service-specific information on the grounds that sales to external customers from a single product or service category exceed 90% of net sales in the consolidated statement of income, and most of consolidated revenue of ¥1,169,289 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 comes from this business.
